      "content": "# SkillHub for DeepSeek Harness

[English](README.en.md)

SkillHub 的 DSH 原生插件。在 DSH 侧栏打开 **技能中心**，匿名浏览、搜索、查看技能详情，并管理安装、升级和卸载；对话中也可搜索和明确请求安装技能。插件内置本地安装核心，无需另装 SkillHub CLI。

`0.2.0` 新增来源可核验的搜索安装状态：广场卡片和对话工具可识别当前来源的受管理安装版本、用户/项目范围及异常记录；对话保留查询时快照。未发现本来源记录不代表其他市场或手工安装不存在，文件存在也不代表 DSH 已启用该技能。按来源、命名空间和技能标识匹配；不按同名目录认领其他来源技能。

`0.2.1` 缺省连接 `https://skill.xfyun.cn`；显式空串或仅空白仍表示断开，已有自定义地址保留。插件不继承 CLI 的默认地址或凭证。

`0.4.0` 使用独立标签 `dsh-v0.4.0`，提供技能案例与原生输入框衔接、对话管理已安装技能及按安装位置独立维护版本。保留 `0.3.1` 的双 RC 兼容范围。公开可用状态以 npm 为准；本地构建的 tarball 可按下文独立验证。

`0.5.0` 新增技能卡片及对话中的只读可用性诊断，分别报告文件完整性、宿主发现和调用策略，保留 `0.4.0` 的兼容范围及库存格式。

`0.6.1` 包含受管理技能启停、统一只读检查更新，以及横向已安装卡片和更多菜单。共享库存继续使用 v2，不要求用户同步升级 CLI；已通过与 CLI 0.2.0 的真实旧包兼容验收。公开可用状态以 npm 为准。

`0.6.2` 已公开发布，包含多来源与更新隔离、升级变化预览及本地文件修改处理、单技能 ZIP 导入导出、本机收藏，以及 DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` 兼容适配。共享库存保持 v2，不要求升级 CLI。

`0.6.3` 为当前补丁候选，交付 [#1080](https://github.com/iflytek/skillhub/pull/1080) 的紧凑工作台、受限只读文件树，以及详情修改入口和升级完成返回修复。保留 `0.6.2` 的来源与库存语义，并新增 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` 精确兼容目标；候选与公开包分别验收，发布前不宣称 npm 已可用。

## 紧凑界面与文件预览（0.6.3）

发现、我的技能、详情和设置共用紧凑控件与明暗主题。文件页按目录树展示当前版本，支持展开/收起和文件切换，并在当前详情引用内保留选中与折叠状态。文件页使用完整内容宽度；顶部“管理安装”回到概览中的位置管理。正文有行号和独立滚动，复制仍只复制原文。详情的“文件”按固定版本读取清单，选择文件后才读取正文；最多展示 500 个文件，单个文本预览上限 256 KiB，超限或二进制仅显示文件信息。正文只读，可复制，不执行 HTML 或加载正文中的远程资源。来源未提供清单、匿名受限与请求失败分别显示；切换来源后旧详情引用失效。复用 Registry 既有文件 GET 接口，仅新增插件本机只读 RPC；不改变 SaaS HTTP API 或共享库存格式。

评论使用既有按技能读取的接口，明确区分加载、空结果和读取失败。市场详情与已安装详情的“查看本地修改”均进入对应安装位置；升级完成后“返回详情”刷新实际库存并打开新版本详情，刷新失败可重试且不重复升级。技能卡片提供轻量悬停与键盘焦点反馈。文件正文当前为原文与行号，不含语言语法高亮。

## 使用已安装技能

市场、已安装列表和对话中的日常列表均按技能展示。点击“使用技能”，由 Host 核验当前会话实际可用的唯一安装；不会让用户猜安装位置。技能中心入口在同一工作区新建对话，对话内入口保留当前会话。案例显示在原生输入框上方，确认案例或自定义任务后填入可编辑草稿；不会自动发送、调用模型或覆盖原会话草稿。

已安装卡片的更多菜单中，“管理安装”进入技能详情，右侧直接展示每个位置的版本和状态，可明确使用此位置、检查更新、启停或卸载。全停用或状态无法确认时先进入管理安装。安装确认中直接展示安装范围，未安装技能仍默认安装到当前用户。

需要当前活动会话。被项目同名技能覆盖、本地文件变更、禁止用户调用或会话/来源变化时会提示原因；历史回执不能代替当前安装状态。此功能自 `0.4.0` 起提供。

## 使用流程

- **浏览技能**：搜索、服务端排序、真实标签筛选、点击加载更多。新目录接口每批 12 项；旧来源首批 404/405 可回退受限搜索，明确提示不支持分页和排序。选中标签失败不会退回未过滤结果。
- **技能详情**：查看文档、版本和可选模块；可“查看此版本”后确认安装指定的可下载版本。已有其他版本时保留覆盖保护，不执行降级。
- **已安装**：按技能聚合并支持关键词过滤。紧凑横向卡片在桌面显示两列、窄屏一列，点击卡片进入详情。可用技能保留“使用技能”主按钮，更多菜单提供“管理安装”和只检查当前技能各安装位置的“检查更新”，不自动执行更新。展示本地技能文件中的名称、一行摘要与实际安装版本；不同位置版本不同时明确标注多个版本。右上角最多显示安装异常/停用与更新状态两个标签（可更新为浅蓝、停用为灰、异常为琥珀色），正常已安装不重复标记。详情右侧按位置显示版本、状态和操作，升级、启停与卸载均只影响确认的位置。目录缺失时仍可清理失效记录。
- **对话搜索**：`astron_skillhub_search` 只搜索，不安装或执行技能。结果提供明确详情动作；详情抽屉可确认安装。
- **对话安装**：用户明确要求安装唯一搜索结果时，不必先打开详情。`astron_skillhub_install` 核验搜索时的精确版本和快照；接受 `selectionRef` 或完整坐标，二者互斥，范围为 `user`/`project`。过期或歧义引用拒绝执行，不改装当前 latest。

本地操作需要活动会话，Host 据此解析可信用户目录和工作区。远程 Host 的文件安装在 Host 所在机器，不在浏览器机器。插件不提供登录、评论提交或权限管理。

安装受理、文件完成、DSH 发现及模型实际使用是不同状态。安装卡主区展示结果，展开“安装记录”可查看核验、当前库存和原操作信息。历史完成不代表当前仍安装该版本，也不代表模型已执行。Host 重启后的历史搜索需要主动“重新查看详情”重新核验，不能恢复旧引用的写权限。

## 更新、回退与缓存

1. 停止提交新操作，等待已受理操作结束；待恢复事务先在原兼容环境处理。
2. 保存当前 tarball，停止使用该 Profile 的 Host。
3. 使用上面的 `plugin ... add` 命令安装目标 tarball，保持 Profile、来源、会话和模型配置不变。
4. 重新启动 Host，重新进入其有效访问入口；浏览器仍显示旧 UI 时进行强制刷新（Windows：Ctrl+Shift+R）。
5. 检查技能中心、配置、现有安装记录和历史查询，再执行测试技能操作。

强制刷新只更新浏览器资源，不会重载 Host 的 Node 模块。依赖变化必须完整重启 Host；禁用/启用插件不能代替依赖重载。官方 RC.2 的 Host 同端口重启可能使原标签页空白，不能承诺无缝重连；保留原操作记录，用有效入口重新进入，不重复提交安装。

回退使用已保留、已验证兼容的 tarball，按相同步骤执行。开发候选替换验证不构成跨正式版本日志兼容承诺。未知日志格式、待恢复事务不能通过删除日志或重装包绕过。插件回退与技能版本降级不是同一功能。

临时停用可在 DSH 插件页关闭本包开关；启用后等待“技能中心”恢复。移除包使用：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile skillhub-test remove @astron-team/skillhub-dsh
```

`remove` 不接受 `--ignore-scripts`。禁用或移除插件不等于卸载技能，不删除技能目录、inventory 或操作日志。操作结果未知时查询原请求；需要恢复时使用界面的“核验并恢复”，不要发起新请求替代恢复。

插件 Host 调用匿名 Registry HTTP API；本地安装事务在 Host 内完成，不需要 SaaS 新增操作用户文件系统的安装接口。开源先定义和验证契约，再将缺失的路径、字段、匿名策略和测试同步到 SaaS。公开 npm `0.2.0` 已对 `https://skill.xfyun.cn` 完成目录、搜索、文档、版本选择和固定版本项目安装及文件/指纹、库存、DSH 发现核验；各版本的构建产物与公开包分别验收。日期格式等无法可靠排序的非 SemVer 版本继续阻断自动升级，不显示可执行升级入口；这不影响已验证的固定版本首次安装。SaaS 技能的真实模型执行尚未验收。详细要求见 [Registry 契约](../../openspec/changes/add-dsh-native-plugin/registry-api-contract.md)。

插件独立使用 `dsh-v<version>` tag，不复用 CLI 或服务镜像发布。`check-dsh-plugin.yml` 配置 Linux/macOS/Windows × Node 24.2.0/当前 Node 24 的普通干净安装检查，并额外保留旧 Cordis 组合的隔离 Host 回归；`release-dsh-plugin.yml` 手动触发，默认只产出候选包。发布需正式版本、可发布 manifest、候选验收及明确发布授权；配置了环境保护规则时还须完成相应审批。版本更新需显式提交，npm 发布需明确授权后运行专用工作流。

具体部署、发布后检查与回退清单见 [发布指南](../../openspec/changes/add-dsh-native-plugin/release-guide.md)，变化见 [发布说明](../../openspec/changes/add-dsh-native-plugin/release-notes.md)。上述 OpenSpec 与测试链接面向源码仓库，不包含在 npm tarball 中。

### 市场交互与安装管理

市场卡片支持点击进入详情及独立安装、卸载、检查更新/升级操作；多范围记录先选择管理目标。用户明确要求安装后，未指定范围默认当前用户；明确指定当前项目时安装到项目。市场卡片的安装按钮也直接打开确认弹窗；默认预选当前用户，项目级位于高级选项，但不自动提交。用户后续明确范围也可发起新调用。详情隐藏完整首部元数据，保留安全 Markdown；公开读取缓存 60 秒，写入仍重新核验。版本 Tab 请求 `downloadableOnly=true`，需要本次开源后端契约；SaaS 尚需单独同步和验收。

安装确认后弹窗保留并向右展开：左侧固定技能、版本和范围，右侧展示简洁的实际进度与结果；窄屏上下排列。处理中不模拟百分比，关闭窗口不取消已提交的安装。

详情页每个安装位置的“更多操作”菜单提供使用此位置、检查可用性、检查更新、停用和卸载；停用位置保留“启用”按钮。菜单不撑高位置卡片，支持方向键选择和 Escape 关闭。检查更新和可用性的普通摘要以“范围/版本 + 一句结论”显示在右上角可关闭通知中；普通成功 5 秒后消失，冲突和失败保留到手动关闭。同一检查替换通知，离开技能详情清除通知。可升级版本和安全阻断仍保留在安装位置中。使用操作继续精确定位所选安装，关闭菜单不会取消正在核验的使用请求。

安装管理以当前库存为准，历史成功不代表仍已安装。“仅此项目”对应项目目录，“所有项目”对应当前 Host 的用户级目录。二级管理中的“安装其他位置”会重新打开安装确认；选择范围不会自动安装。

从“管理安装”的对应位置发起卸载，确认框保留技能、版本、范围和影响说明。打开仅核验，确认才执行；取消与 Esc 不卸载，过期计划和异常安装仍由原事务校验阻断。

切换版本只查看内容，不会自动更新。已安装时选择可核验的较新版本，可“升级到该版本”；同版本不重复升级，旧版本不支持降级，不可排序版本阻断升级。确认框只列出本次选定的安装位置。检查最新版仍可从市场或已安装列表使用；升级原地确认，保留本地修改保护与恢复。


### 对话管理已安装技能

- `astron_skillhub_list_installed`：当前来源在当前用户/项目中的受管理记录，不代表全机技能；文件存在不是内容完整性证明。
- `astron_skillhub_check_update`：以列表中的位置引用检查最新或指定较新版本；失败、无更新和不可升级分别展示。
- `astron_skillhub_upgrade` / `astron_skillhub_uninstall`：必须使用列表中的精确引用，并由 Host 发起真实用户确认。模型不能传路径、确认标志或执行计划。原生问答不可用时返回确认卡；取消不修改文件。
- `astron_skillhub_operation`：以原回执查询本会话操作结果，不重复提交操作；历史成功不代表当前仍安装。

多份安装先选择目标；更新不改变其他位置版本。本地修改、来源/会话变化和失效引用阻止操作。共享库存兼容已发布 CLI 0.2.0；旧版显式覆盖与删除仍遵循原语义。


### 技能可用性诊断（0.5.0）

在技能卡片中打开“管理安装”，选择对应位置的“检查可用性”。也可以在对话中询问“这个技能为什么不能用”，由 `astron_skillhub_check_availability` 返回只读结果。

诊断分别核验本地文件、当前会话加载结果，以及用户/模型调用策略。同名技能生效、本地修改和宿主无法核验会给出不同结论。按技能名查询只说明当前宿主观察到的事实，不证明安装来源或内容完整性。检查不会修改、卸载、启停技能或发送消息；历史结果不保证下一次调用仍然可用。


## 受管理技能启停（0.6.1）

在“管理安装”中，对明确位置选择“停用”或“启用”。用户级和项目级副本独立管理；停用用户副本不会关闭项目副本。页面与对话均需真实用户确认，取消不写文件。对话工具 `astron_skillhub_disable` / `astron_skillhub_enable` 使用新查询中的位置引用，不能提交自由路径。

停用保留技能目录、版本和资源，只将入口 `SKILL.md` 转换为 `SKILL.md.disabled`；启用恢复入口。目标文件被占用、内容修改、共享归属或安装记录不可信时拒绝操作。停用中仍可通过 DSH 检查更新、更新及卸载，更新后继续停用。

这不撤回会话已加载的正文，也不终止任务；同名的其他安装可能继续可用。宿主缓存未确认时明确显示未知，不把文件操作成功当作发现已刷新。旧 RC 的同名接替可能需新会话才能观察到。卸载插件不会自动启用这些技能。

协议与旧包交替操作验收仍是发布门禁，详见上文。

详情标题旁“在官网查看”仅使用详情API返回的可选`webUrl`。字段缺失、null、空白或不安全时隐藏按钮，详情与安装照常使用。插件不再提供网站地址配置、不拼路由、不从Registry回退；旧`websiteUrl`配置忽略。开源服务端复用可信`SKILLHUB_PUBLIC_BASE_URL`生成完整地址，未配置合法网站基址则返回null。SaaS需单独同步此可选字段。

安装确认直接展示安装范围，默认范围规则不变。确认、进行中与成功共用稳定的双栏布局，小屏自动纵排；右侧在提交前显示等待提示，完成后使用按钮与进度条分开显示。

已安装页可主动“检查更新”，以最多 3 个并发检查当前可见的安装位置，并渐进显示进度、可更新技能数与失败位置数；支持关键词叠加全部/可更新/检查失败筛选及失败重试。每项检查最多等待 30 秒，失败不会视为已最新。打开详情或离开列表会取消在途检查，详情返回保留仍有效的结果；来源、会话、工作区或安装引用变化后旧结果失效；进入详情后按位置展示已检查的目标版本，执行前仍重新核验。检查只读，更新仍需在详情按具体位置确认。

### 升级变化与本地文件修改

在已安装技能详情中可直接查看本地修改，不必先执行升级。比较以该安装来源、精确版本及发布指纹对应的原始内容为准；原文无法取得或校验失败时明确显示不可用，不以另一来源的同名技能替代。

升级先检查本地修改：可以确认撤销单个文件或全部修改，也可选择「备份修改并继续」。备份成功后进入独立版本变化预览，最后点击「确认升级」才更新技能。取消预览不改技能，也不会删除已创建的备份。文件差异按需读取，文本过大或二进制文件会显示预览限制；每个展开文件独立滚动。

撤销只恢复当前安装版本的文件：已修改文件还原原文、本地新增文件删除、本地删除文件恢复；已安装版本、归属及启停状态不变。不提供版本降级或升级后回滚。确认后文件再次变化时需重新检查。

持久备份保存在 DSH Home 的 `skillhub/backups` 目录，与技能目录分离；单份上限 100 MiB、总量 1 GiB、最多 20 份，达到上限拒绝新备份，首期不自动删除。备份失败不覆盖，备份后又有本地修改也需重新处理。本地文件仅在 Host 比较和备份，不上传 Registry。

对话卡片上的人工更新确认同样进入变化预览。模型工具仍保留原有无本地修改时的升级确认语义，不具备备份覆盖授权；发现本地修改时继续拒绝，需由用户进入页面处理。

## 本地收藏

详情中的心形“收藏”按钮用于添加或取消本机收藏；普通发现卡片不提供收藏按钮。浏览页的“仅看收藏”读取当前来源的完整收藏列表，收藏列表卡片可直接取消收藏；可直接搜索，不依赖已加载的市场分页。收藏不安装技能、不改变网站收藏数，也不需要登录。点击收藏项时重新解析当前可下载版本；离线或下架不删除收藏，也不自动安装旧版本。

SkillHub is a self-hosted platform that gives teams a private,
governed place to share agent skills. Publish a skill package, push
it to a namespace, and let others find it through search or
install it via CLI. Built for on-premise deployment behind your
firewall, with the same polish you'd expect from a public registry.

> ⭐ If SkillHub fits your team, **star** the repo to help other teams find it, and **Watch → Custom → Releases** to get notified when a new version ships.

## Share Great Skills

Great Skills become more valuable when they are shared. If you have a Skill that has
proved useful in real work or everyday life, share it with the SkillHub community and
help grow an open, practical Skill ecosystem. We welcome Skills for daily life, office
work, learning and research, travel and events, content creation, data analysis, and
software development—not only engineering workflows.

High-quality community contributions may join the curated starter collection, making new
SkillHub deployments useful from day one. You do not need to finish the full adaptation
before joining in: [open an issue](https://github.com/iflytek/skillhub/issues/new/choose)
with the Skill's source and the problem it solves, or submit a PR by following the
[Skill sharing guide](./builtin-skills/README.md).

## Highlights

- **Self-Hosted & Private** — Deploy on your own infrastructure.
  Keep proprietary skills behind your firewall with full data
  sovereignty. One `make dev-all` command to get running locally.
- **Publish & Version** — Upload agent skill packages with semantic
  versioning, custom tags (`beta`, `stable`), and automatic
  `latest` tracking.
- **Discover** — Full-text search with filters by namespace,
  downloads, ratings, and recency. Visibility rules ensure
  users only see what they're authorized to.
- **Team Namespaces** — Organize skills under team or global scopes.
  Each namespace has its own members, roles (Owner / Admin /
  Member), and publishing policies.
- **Review & Governance** — Team admins review within their namespace;
  platform admins gate promotions to the global scope. Governance
  actions are audit-logged for compliance.
- **Social Features** — Star skills, rate them, and track downloads.
  Build a community around your organization's best practices.
- **Account Merging** — Consolidate multiple OAuth identities and
  API tokens under a single user account.
- **API Token Management** — Generate scoped tokens for CLI and
  programmatic access with prefix-based secure hashing.
- **CLI-First** — Native REST API plus a compatibility layer for
  existing ClawHub-style registry clients. Native CLI APIs are the
  primary supported path while protocol compatibility continues to
  expand.
- **Pluggable Storage** — Local filesystem for development, S3 /
  MinIO for production. Swap via config.
- **Internationalization** — Multi-language support with i18next: English, Simplified Chinese, Russian, and Korean.

### Container Runtime

Published runtime images are built by GitHub Actions and pushed to GHCR.
This is the supported path for anyone who wants a ready-to-use local
environment without building the backend or frontend on their machine.
Published server and web images target `linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`, and
`linux/riscv64`; the scanner image currently targets `linux/amd64` and
`linux/arm64`.

**Quick deployment with curl:**

```bash
# Default (GHCR images)
curl -fsSL https://imageless.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/runtime.sh | sh -s -- up --public-url https://skillhub.your-company.com

# Aliyun mirror (recommended for users in China)
curl -fsSL https://imageless.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/runtime.sh | sh -s -- up --aliyun --public-url https://skillhub.your-company.com --version latest

```

**Deployment parameters:**

| Parameter | Description | Example |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| `--public-url <url>` | Public access URL (recommended) | `--public-url https://skill.example.com` |
| `--version <tag>` | Specific image tag | `--version v0.2.25` |
| `--ref <git-ref>` | Git ref for deployment files (GitHub raw mode) | `--ref v0.2.25` |
| `--aliyun` | Use Aliyun mirror (China) | `--aliyun` |
| `--home <dir>` | Runtime directory | `--home /opt/skillhub` |
| `--no-scanner` | Disable security scanner | `--no-scanner` |

`--version` selects image tags; it does not pin the deployment files. By default,
those files come from `main`. To pin the installer, Compose file, environment
template and application image tag together, use a released Git ref and tag:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iflytek/skillhub/v0.2.25/scripts/runtime.sh | sh -s -- up --ref v0.2.25 --version v0.2.25 --home /opt/skillhub --public-url https://skillhub.your-company.com
```

This example uses GitHub raw and requires access to it. With the updated installer,
`--aliyun` keeps only the three core files (`runtime.sh`, `compose.release.yml`, and
`.env.release.example`) on the OSS root. The five optional analytics/Collector
configuration files are fetched on demand through `gh-proxy.org`, using `--ref`
(or `SKILLHUB_REF`, default `main`), just like the ordinary GitHub source. There is
no installer-side commit or checksum list to update when editing these templates.
Every use downloads the selected ref again; `main` is mutable and proxy caching
means it is not guaranteed to reflect the latest commit immediately. For production,
select a reviewed release tag or commit with `--ref` and a matching image `--version`.
OSS core files are still not versioned by `--ref`; the publisher must keep them
compatible with the chosen release. `--version` alone does not select a file ref.
Download failures, empty responses and obvious wrong-format responses stop the optional
operation without replacing the existing destination. This basic format check is
not full YAML validation or cryptographic source verification: using the proxy
requires trusting that third party. Availability is not guaranteed, and there is
no silent fallback to another ref.
Likewise, a custom `SKILLHUB_RAW_BASE` takes precedence over the Git-ref URL.
The explicit custom source retains its existing behavior and does not use the
default proxy path. Neither OSS core files nor an explicit custom source should
be described as pinned by `--ref`.
The script preserves an existing `.env.release`; record its settings and explicit
image overrides separately. Pinning the application tag does not freeze every
dependency image or replace a database backup.

> **Important**: Configure `--public-url` for production deployments to ensure CLI install commands and Agent setup instructions display the correct URLs.

For sub-path deployments, keep the public URL and runtime base path aligned in
`.env.release`: set `SKILLHUB_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://skill.example.com/skillhub`,
`SKILLHUB_WEB_BASE_PATH=/skillhub/`, and `SKILLHUB_WEB_API_BASE_URL=/skillhub`.

**Manual deployment:**

1. Copy the runtime environment template.
2. Pick an image tag.
3. Start the stack with Docker Compose.

```bash
cp .env.release.example .env.release
```

Recommended image tags:

- `SKILLHUB_VERSION=latest` for the latest stable release (default)
- `SKILLHUB_VERSION=edge` for the latest `main` build
- `SKILLHUB_VERSION=vX.Y.Z` for a fixed release

Start the runtime:

```bash
make validate-release-config
docker compose --env-file .env.release -f compose.release.yml up -d
```

Then open:

- Web UI: `SKILLHUB_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` 对应的地址
- Backend API: `http://localhost:8080`

Stop it with:

```bash
docker compose --env-file .env.release -f compose.release.yml down
```

The runtime stack uses its own Compose project name, so it does not
collide with containers from `make dev-all`.

The production Compose stack now defaults to the `docker` profile only.
It does not enable local mock auth. The release template (`.env.release.example`)
enables the bootstrap admin by default, so zero-config quickstart via
`runtime.sh` works out of the box:

- username: `admin`
- password: `ChangeMe!2026`

Recommended production baseline:

- set `SKILLHUB_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` to the final HTTPS entrypoint
- if the service is published under a sub-path such as `/skillhub/`, set
  `SKILLHUB_WEB_BASE_PATH=/skillhub/` and `SKILLHUB_WEB_API_BASE_URL=/skillhub`
  as well
- keep PostgreSQL / Redis bound to `127.0.0.1`

- rotate or disable the bootstrap admin after initial setup

If the GHCR package remains private, run `docker login ghcr.io` before

### Upload Allowlist Override

Skill package upload validation uses the default extension allowlist from
[`SkillPackagePolicy.java`](./server/skillhub-domain/src/main/java/com/iflytek/skillhub/domain/skill/validation/SkillPackagePolicy.java).
`SkillPublishProperties` uses that same list by default for

Spring Boot binds this environment variable to
`skillhub.publish.allowed-file-extensions`. When set, it replaces the default
allowlist instead of appending to it.

### Monitoring

The optional [`monitoring/`](./monitoring) directory provides Prometheus and Grafana deployment examples. It is not a ready-to-scrape backend configuration: the default application exposes only `health` and `info` Actuator endpoints. `/actuator/prometheus` also requires the `SUPER_ADMIN` or `AUDITOR` role under the current route policy, while the example scraper has no credentials configured.

After adapting that configuration, start the optional stack:

```bash

```

Prometheus uses port `9090` and Grafana uses port `3001`. Replace the example Grafana administrator credentials before exposing it. Confirm scrape targets are healthy and metrics are present; starting the containers alone does not establish monitoring coverage. ## SkillHub and the Agent Skills Ecosystem

SkillHub is a **registry and governance platform** — not a skill collection.
It is complementary to open skill catalogs such as
[`anthropics/skills`](https://github.com/anthropics/skills): that repository
popularized the **Agent Skill format** (a `SKILL.md` with `name` / `description`
frontmatter plus supporting files) and ships a curated set of example skills.
SkillHub is where your organization **hosts, versions, governs, and distributes**
those skills privately.

|  | [`anthropics/skills`](https://github.com/anthropics/skills) | **SkillHub** |
|---|---|---|
| What it is | A curated collection of example Agent Skills + the format spec | A self-hosted registry & governance platform for skills |
| Layer | Content — the skills themselves | Infrastructure — hosting, versioning, discovery, access control |
| Hosting | Public GitHub repository | Your own infrastructure, behind your firewall |
| Versioning | Git history | Semantic versions, tags (`beta` / `stable`), `latest` tracking |
| Access control | Public | Namespaces, RBAC, review & audit logging |
| Distribution | Clone / copy files | Full-text search + CLI install |

Because SkillHub speaks the same `SKILL.md` format, skills from `anthropics/skills`
— or any Agent Skill folder — publish straight into your registry:

```bash
# Grab a skill from an open collection...
git clone https://github.com/anthropics/skills

# ...and publish it into your private SkillHub registry
export SKILLHUB_REGISTRY=https://skillhub.your-company.com
export SKILLHUB_TOKEN=YOUR_API_TOKEN
npx @astron-team/skillhub@latest publish ./skills/<category>/<skill-name>
```

> ⚖️ **Licensing**: honor each skill's own license when republishing. Most skills in
> `anthropics/skills` are Apache 2.0, but the document skills (DOCX/PDF/PPTX/XLSX) are
> source-available rather than open source — check the skill's `LICENSE` before redistributing.

**In short: use collections like `anthropics/skills` for content, and SkillHub to
distribute it across your organization under governance.**

## Usage with Agent Platforms

SkillHub works as a skill registry backend for several agent platforms. Point any of the clients below at your SkillHub instance to publish, discover, and install skills.

### [OpenClaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw)

[OpenClaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw) is an open-source agent skill CLI. Configure it to use your SkillHub endpoint as the registry:

```bash
# Configure registry URL
export CLAWHUB_REGISTRY=https://skillhub.your-company.com

# Authenticate once if needed
clawhub login --token YOUR_API_TOKEN

# Search and install skills
npx clawhub search email
npx clawhub install my-skill
npx clawhub install my-namespace--my-skill

# Publishing uses the first-party SkillHub CLI
export SKILLHUB_REGISTRY=https://skillhub.your-company.com
export SKILLHUB_TOKEN=YOUR_API_TOKEN
npx @astron-team/skillhub@latest publish ./my-skill --namespace my-space
```

`my-space--my-skill` is the canonical compat slug. SkillHub parses it as
namespace `my-space` plus skill slug `my-skill`.

ClawHub compatibility covers search, inspection, and installation. Its publish
protocol is not compatible with SkillHub; use the first-party CLI shown above.

> 💡 **Tip**: The above commands are not only applicable to OpenClaw, but also to other CLI Coding Agents or Agent assistants by specifying the installation directory (`--dir`). For example: `npx clawhub --dir ~/.claude/skills install my-skill`

📖 **[Complete OpenClaw Integration Guide →](./docs/openclaw-integration.md)**

### [Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent)

[Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent) uses the standard `SKILL.md` format and recursively discovers skills under `$HERMES_HOME/skills/`. ### [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

```bash
skillhub install my-skill --agent dsh --scope user
```

Project-scoped installs use `<repository>/.dsh/skills`; run them from the repository root. dsh watches its skill roots, so newly installed skills are discovered without restarting the process.


      try { return { scope, target: await resolveInstalledPath({ scope, cwd, fs, signal: combined }) }; }

      result => ({ result, error: undefined }), error => ({ result: undefined, error }),

    }
    for (const target of roots) {
      let current: ResolvedInstallationTarget;

    if (runtime!.getStatus().pendingOperations > 0) return { ...base, reason: 'recovery-required' };

    for (const target of baseline.targets) {

  private installedItemKey(sessionId: string, cwd: string, sourceRevision: string, item: InstalledProjectionItem & { registry?: string }): string {

      sessionId, cwd, sourceRevision, item.registry ?? this.getContext().registryUrl.replace(/\/+$/, ''), item.scope, item.namespace, item.slug, item.version,
      item.targetPath, item.fingerprint ?? null, item.state, item.recordRevision ?? null, item.installationState ?? 'enabled',

  private async readInstalledItem(sourceRevision: string, itemKey: string, signal: AbortSignal, agentId?: string) {
    this.assertSource(sourceRevision);
    const id = agentId ?? this.ctx.invocation?.request.args.agentId;
    const agent = typeof id === 'string' ? this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(id)) : undefined;
    const runtime = this.localRuntime;
    const fs = agent?.ctx.get('fs');
    const cwd = agent?.session.header.cwd;

    const valid = () => {
      this.assertSource(sourceRevision);
      if (!agent || !runtime || !fs || !cwd || sessionId !== agent.session.id || cwd !== agent.session.header.cwd
        || this.localRuntime !== runtime || this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agent.session.id)) !== agent
        || serviceIdentity(agent.ctx.get('fs')) !== serviceIdentity(fs)) {
        throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Reopen the installed skill list.', { retryable: false });
      }
    };
    valid();
    const combined = AbortSignal.any([signal, this.lifetime.signal]);
    // Re-read trusted roots rather than retaining an evictable cache or decoding client paths.
    const roots: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof resolveInstalledPath>>[] = [];

      try { roots.push(await resolveInstalledPath({ scope, cwd: cwd!, fs: fs!, signal: combined })); }

    const result = await runtime!.listAllInstalled(roots);

  }

  private async executePlanForAgent(agentId: string, request: HostExecutePlanRequest, signal: AbortSignal, initiatedFrom: 'plaza' | 'conversation'): Promise<NativeOperation | null> {
    const agent = this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agentId));
    const runtime = this.localRuntime;
    const hostInstanceId = runtime?.getStatus().hostInstanceId;
    if (!agent || !runtime || !hostInstanceId) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Mutation context unavailable.', { retryable: false });
    try {
      const previous = await runtime.findPlanOperation({ hostInstanceId, ownerId: agent.session.id, requestKey: request.requestKey,
        mode: 'retry', parameters: { planId: request.planId } });
      if (previous) return previous;
      if (this.togglePlans.has(request.planId)) {
        return await runtime.submitToggle({ hostInstanceId, ownerId: agent.session.id, requestKey: request.requestKey,
          mode: 'new', parameters: { planId: request.planId } }, async () => {
          const combined = AbortSignal.any([signal, this.lifetime.signal]);
          combined.throwIfAborted();
          const context = this.selectionScope(agent);
          const baseline = this.togglePlans.read(request.planId, context);
          const filesystem = agent.ctx.get('fs');
          if (!filesystem) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Filesystem unavailable.', { retryable: false });
          const policy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
          const target = await resolveInstallationPath({ scope: baseline.target.scope, cwd: context.cwd, fs: filesystem, policy, signal: combined });
          if (target.root !== baseline.target.root) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Removal root changed.', { retryable: false });
          const valid = () => {
            if (agent.session.header.cwd !== context.cwd || serviceIdentity(agent.ctx.get('fs')) !== serviceIdentity(filesystem)
              || this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agent.session.id)) !== agent || this.localRuntime !== runtime) {
              throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Removal session changed.', { retryable: false });
            }
          };
          valid(); combined.throwIfAborted(); this.assertSource(context.sourceRevision);
          this.togglePlans.claim(request.planId, context, request.requestKey);
          const item = baseline.inventoryItem;
          const operationSignal = new AbortController().signal;
          return {
            acceptance: { kind: baseline.afterState === 'enabled' ? 'enable' : 'disable', namespace: item.namespace, slug: item.slug, version: item.targets.find(target => target.installDir === baseline.target.path)!.version,
              targetLabel: target.scope === 'user' ? '当前用户' : '当前项目', targetPaths: [baseline.target.path],
              context: { sourceIdentity: item.registry, sourceLabel: item.registry, sourceRevision: context.sourceRevision,
                hostLabel: 'DSH Host', initiatedFrom } },
            execution: { baseline, authorize: async (paths: readonly string[]) => {
              valid();
              const currentPolicy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
              const current = await resolveInstallationPath({ scope: target.scope, cwd: context.cwd, fs: filesystem,
                policy: currentPolicy, signal: operationSignal });
              valid();
              if (current.root !== target.root || current.dshHome !== target.dshHome) throw new Error('Removal root changed');
              await assertInstallationMutation(target.root, paths, currentPolicy);
            } },
          };
        }) ?? null;
      }
      if (this.removalPlans.has(request.planId)) {
        return await runtime.submitRemoval({ hostInstanceId, ownerId: agent.session.id, requestKey: request.requestKey,
          mode: 'new', parameters: { planId: request.planId } }, async () => {
          const combined = AbortSignal.any([signal, this.lifetime.signal]);
          combined.throwIfAborted();
          const context = this.selectionScope(agent);
          const baseline = this.removalPlans.read(request.planId, context);
          const filesystem = agent.ctx.get('fs');
          if (!filesystem) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Filesystem unavailable.', { retryable: false });
          const policy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
          const target = await resolveInstallationPath({ scope: baseline.target.scope, cwd: context.cwd, fs: filesystem, policy, signal: combined });
          if (target.root !== baseline.target.root) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Removal root changed.', { retryable: false });
          const valid = () => {
            if (agent.session.header.cwd !== context.cwd || serviceIdentity(agent.ctx.get('fs')) !== serviceIdentity(filesystem)
              || this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agent.session.id)) !== agent || this.localRuntime !== runtime) {
              throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Removal session changed.', { retryable: false });
            }
          };
          valid(); combined.throwIfAborted(); this.assertSource(context.sourceRevision);
          this.removalPlans.claim(request.planId, context, request.requestKey);
          const item = baseline.inventoryItem;
          const operationSignal = new AbortController().signal;
          return {
            acceptance: { kind: baseline.kind, namespace: item.namespace, slug: item.slug, version: item.targets.find(target => target.installDir === baseline.target.path)!.version,
              targetLabel: target.scope === 'user' ? '当前用户' : '当前项目', targetPaths: [baseline.target.path],
              context: { sourceIdentity: item.registry, sourceLabel: item.registry, sourceRevision: context.sourceRevision,
                hostLabel: 'DSH Host', initiatedFrom } },
            execution: { baseline, authorize: async (paths: readonly string[], _phase: string, operationId: string) => {
              valid();
              const currentPolicy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
              const current = await resolveInstallationPath({ scope: target.scope, cwd: context.cwd, fs: filesystem,
                policy: currentPolicy, signal: operationSignal });
              valid();
              if (current.root !== target.root || current.dshHome !== target.dshHome) throw new Error('Removal root changed');
              await assertRemovalMutation(target.root, item.slug, operationId, paths, currentPolicy);
            } },
          };
        }) ?? null;
      }
      return await runtime.submitUpgrade({ hostInstanceId, ownerId: agent.session.id, requestKey: request.requestKey,
        mode: 'new', parameters: { planId: request.planId } }, async () => {
        const combined = AbortSignal.any([signal, this.lifetime.signal]);
        combined.throwIfAborted();
        const context = this.selectionScope(agent);
        const snapshot = this.upgradePlans.read(request.planId, context);
        const source = this.getContext();
        const filesystem = agent.ctx.get('fs');
        if (!filesystem) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Filesystem unavailable.', { retryable: false });
        const policy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
        const targets: ResolvedInstallationTarget[] = [];
        for (const target of snapshot.baseline.targets) {
          const current = await resolveInstallationPath({ scope: target.scope, cwd: context.cwd, fs: filesystem, policy, signal: combined });
          if (current.root !== target.root) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Upgrade root changed.', { retryable: false });
          targets.push(current);
        }
        combined.throwIfAborted();
        this.assertSource(context.sourceRevision);
        if (agent.session.header.cwd !== context.cwd || serviceIdentity(agent.ctx.get('fs')) !== serviceIdentity(filesystem)
          || this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agent.session.id)) !== agent || this.localRuntime !== runtime) {
          throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Upgrade session changed.', { retryable: false });

          acceptance: { namespace: candidate.namespace, slug: candidate.slug, version: candidate.version,
            targetLabel: targets.map(target => target.scope === 'user' ? '当前用户' : '当前项目').join('、'),
            targetPaths: snapshot.baseline.targets.map(target => target.path),
            context: { sourceIdentity: source.registryUrl, sourceLabel: source.registryUrl, sourceRevision: context.sourceRevision,
              hostLabel: 'DSH Host', initiatedFrom } },
          execution: { registry: source.registryUrl, namespace: candidate.namespace, slug: candidate.slug,

              const currentPolicy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
              const roots = [];
              for (const target of targets) {
                const current = await resolveInstallationPath({ scope: target.scope, cwd: context.cwd, fs, policy: currentPolicy, signal: operationSignal });
                if (current.root !== target.root || current.dshHome !== target.dshHome) throw new Error('Upgrade root changed');
                roots.push(current.root);
              }
              for (const path of paths) {
                // A mutation batch can contain paths from both approved roots.
                let allowed = false;
                for (const root of roots) {
                  try { await assertInstallationMutation(root, [path], currentPolicy); allowed = true; break; }
                  catch { /* Try the other explicitly confirmed root. */ }
                }
                if (!allowed) throw new Error('Upgrade mutation is outside the confirmed roots');
              }
            },
            validateStaged: (directory: string) => validateDshSkill(agent.ctx, directory, operationSignal),
          }
        };
      }) ?? null;
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof RemoteError) throw error;
      if (error && typeof error === 'object' && 'code' in error && error.code === 'REQUEST_KEY_CONFLICT') {
        throw new RemoteError('skillhub/request-conflict', 'Request parameters changed.', { retryable: false });
      }
      throw new RemoteError('skillhub/installation-unavailable', 'Mutation request could not be accepted.', { retryable: true });
    }
  }

  @RemoteScope('agent')
  async openConversationDetail(selectionRef: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<ConversationDetail> {
    const id = this.ctx.invocation?.request.args.agentId;
    const agent = typeof id === 'string' ? this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(id)) : undefined;
    if (!agent) throw installationContextError('AGENT', 'Conversation unavailable.');
    const selection = this.conversationSelection(agent, selectionRef);
    const detail = await this.getSkillDetail(selection.sourceRevision, selection.namespace, selection.slug, selection.version, signal);
    this.conversationSelection(agent, selectionRef);
    const snapshot = this.details.get(detail.detailToken);
    if (!snapshot) throw installationContextError('DETAIL', 'Detail expired.');
    const fixedRef = this.selections.stage(selectionRef, this.selectionScope(agent), detail.detailToken, snapshot);
    const pendingOrigin = this.pendingConversationChoices.get(selectionRef);
    if (pendingOrigin) this.pendingConversationChoices.set(fixedRef, pendingOrigin);
    return { ...detail, selectionRef: fixedRef };
  }

  /** Reissue only from this session's trusted search log; never restore old authorization. */
  @RemoteScope('agent')
  async reopenConversationDetail(callId: string, selectionRef: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<ConversationDetail> {
    const stale = () => new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Search history unavailable. Search again in this conversation.', { retryable: false });
    const id = this.ctx.invocation?.request.args.agentId;
    const agent = typeof id === 'string' ? this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(id)) : undefined;
    const query = this.ctx.get('sessionQuery');
    if (!agent || !query || !callId || callId.length > 1024 || typeof selectionRef !== 'string') throw stale();
    const scope = this.selectionScope(agent);
    const source = this.registry!.source;
    const check = () => {
      signal.throwIfAborted();
      this.lifetime.signal.throwIfAborted();
      const current = this.selectionScope(agent);
      if (this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(scope.sessionId)) !== agent
        || serviceIdentity(this.ctx.get('sessionQuery')) !== serviceIdentity(query)
        || current.sessionId !== scope.sessionId || current.cwd !== scope.cwd
        || current.sourceRevision !== scope.sourceRevision) throw stale();
    };
    check();
    let history;
    try { history = await query.readSession(SessionId(scope.sessionId)); }
    catch { throw stale(); }
    check();
    const candidate = historicalSearchCandidate(history, scope, source, callId, selectionRef);
    if (!candidate) throw stale();
    const detail = await this.getSkillDetail(scope.sourceRevision, candidate.namespace, candidate.slug, candidate.version, signal);
    check();
    const snapshot = this.details.get(detail.detailToken);
    if (!snapshot) throw stale();
    const fresh = this.selections.add({ ...scope, callId }, candidate);
    const fixed = this.selections.stage(fresh, scope, detail.detailToken, snapshot);
    return { ...detail, selectionRef: fixed };
  }

  @RemoteScope('agent')
  acknowledgeConversationDetail(selectionRef: string, detailToken: string): boolean {

    if (!agent) throw installationContextError('AGENT', 'Conversation unavailable.');

    const id = this.ctx.invocation?.request.args.agentId;
    const agent = typeof id === 'string' ? this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(id)) : undefined;

  private async installationTargetsFor(agentId: string, detailToken: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<InstallationTargetList> {
    const agent = this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agentId));
    if (!agent) throw installationContextError('AGENT', 'Conversation unavailable.');
    const context = { ...this.selectionScope(agent), detailToken };
    const detail = this.details.get(detailToken);
    const runtime = this.localRuntime;
    if (!detail || !detail.fingerprint) throw installationContextError('DETAIL', 'Detail expired.');
    if (detail.sourceRevision !== context.sourceRevision) throw installationContextError('SOURCE', 'Detail expired.');
    if (!runtime || runtime.getStatus().state !== 'ready') {
      throw new RemoteError('skillhub/installation-unavailable', 'Local installation service is unavailable.', { retryable: true });
    }
    const fs = agent.ctx.get('fs');
    if (!fs) return { hostInstanceId: runtime.getStatus().hostInstanceId!, targets: [], unavailable: ['user', 'project'] };
    const combined = AbortSignal.any([signal, this.lifetime.signal]);
    const policy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
    const resolved = await Promise.all((['user', 'project'] as const).map(async scope => {
      try { return { scope, target: await resolveInstallationPath({ scope, cwd: context.cwd, fs, policy, signal: combined }) }; }
      catch { combined.throwIfAborted(); return { scope, target: undefined }; }
    }));
    combined.throwIfAborted();
    const current = this.selectionScope(agent);
    const currentPolicy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
    if (current.cwd !== context.cwd) throw installationContextError('CWD');
    if (current.sourceRevision !== context.sourceRevision) throw installationContextError('SOURCE');
    if (this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(context.sessionId)) !== agent) throw installationContextError('AGENT');
    if (serviceIdentity(agent.ctx.get('fs')) !== serviceIdentity(fs)) throw installationContextError('FS');
    if (currentPolicy?.mode !== policy?.mode || currentPolicy?.workspaceRoot !== policy?.workspaceRoot) throw installationContextError('POLICY');
    if (this.localRuntime !== runtime || runtime.getStatus().state !== 'ready') throw installationContextError('RUNTIME');
    if (this.details.get(detailToken) !== detail) throw installationContextError('DETAIL');
    return {
      hostInstanceId: runtime.getStatus().hostInstanceId!,
      targets: resolved.flatMap(({ target }) => target ? [this.installationTargets.issue(context, target)] : []),
      unavailable: resolved.filter(({ target }) => !target).map(({ scope }) => scope),
    };
  }

  @RemoteScope('agent')
  async startInstall(input: HostInstallRequest, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<NativeOperation | null> {
    const id = this.ctx.invocation?.request.args.agentId;
    const agent = typeof id === 'string' ? this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(id)) : undefined;
    if (!agent) throw installationContextError('AGENT', 'Conversation unavailable.');
    // The generated object codec strips unknown nested fields; validate the original wire object too.
    const parsed = installRequest.safeParse(this.ctx.invocation?.request.args.input ?? input);
    if (!parsed.success) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/invalid-installation-request', 'Invalid installation request.', { retryable: false });
    try { return await this.submitInstallation(agent.session.id, parsed.data, signal) ?? null; }
    catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof RemoteError) throw error;
      const code = error && typeof error === 'object' && 'code' in error ? error.code : undefined;
      if (code === 'REQUEST_KEY_CONFLICT') throw new RemoteError('skillhub/request-conflict', 'Request parameters changed.', { retryable: false });
      if (code === 'HOST_MISMATCH') throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Host identity changed.', { retryable: false });
      throw new RemoteError('skillhub/installation-unavailable', 'Installation request could not be accepted.', { retryable: true });
    }
  }

  @RemoteScope('agent')
  async getOperation(operationId: string, hostInstanceId: string): Promise<NativeOperation | null> {
    const id = this.ctx.invocation?.request.args.agentId;
    const agent = typeof id === 'string' ? this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(id)) : undefined;
    if (!agent) throw installationContextError('AGENT', 'Conversation unavailable.');
    if (!operationQuery.safeParse({ operationId, hostInstanceId }).success) {
      throw new RemoteError('skillhub/invalid-installation-request', 'Invalid operation query.', { retryable: false });
    }
    const runtime = this.localRuntime;
    if (!runtime || runtime.getStatus().state !== 'ready') throw new RemoteError('skillhub/installation-unavailable', 'Local service unavailable.', { retryable: true });
    if (runtime.getStatus().hostInstanceId !== hostInstanceId) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Host identity changed.', { retryable: false });
    try {
      const operation = await runtime.getOperation(operationId, agent.session.id);
      if (!operation) return null;
      if (operation.phase !== 'completed' || !['install', 'upgrade'].includes(operation.kind)) return operation;
      const cwd = agent.session.header.cwd;
      const fs = agent.ctx.get('fs');
      const skills = this.ctx.get('skills');
      if (!cwd || !fs || !skills) return operation;
      const signal = AbortSignal.any([this.lifetime.signal, AbortSignal.timeout(2000)]);
      try {
        const roots = await Promise.all((['user', 'project'] as const).map(async scope => {
          try { return await resolveInstalledPath({ scope, cwd, fs, signal }); }
          catch { return undefined; }
        }));
        const confirmed = await runtime.observeInstallation(operationId, agent.session.id,
          roots.flatMap(root => root ? [root.root] : []),
          paths => observeDshInstallation(agent.ctx, paths, signal,
            name => skills.get(name, { scope: agent, cwd, signal })));
        signal.throwIfAborted();
        if (confirmed && agent.session.header.cwd === cwd && this.localRuntime === runtime
          && this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agent.session.id)) === agent
          && serviceIdentity(agent.ctx.get('fs')) === serviceIdentity(fs)
          && serviceIdentity(this.ctx.get('skills')) === serviceIdentity(skills)) return { ...operation, discovery: 'confirmed' };
      } catch { /* Discovery uncertainty does not replace a successful file result. */ }
      return { ...operation, discovery: 'unconfirmed' };
    }
    catch { throw new RemoteError('skillhub/installation-unavailable', 'Operation could not be read.', { retryable: true }); }
  }

  @RemoteScope('agent')
  async recoverOperation(input: HostRecoveryRequest): Promise<NativeOperation | null> {
    const parsed = operationQuery.safeParse(this.ctx.invocation?.request.args.input ?? input);
    if (!parsed.success) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/invalid-installation-request', 'Invalid recovery request.', { retryable: false });
    const { operationId, hostInstanceId } = parsed.data;
    const operation = await this.getOperation(operationId, hostInstanceId);
    if (!operation) return null;
    if (!['install', 'upgrade', 'uninstall', 'remove-stale-record', 'enable', 'disable'].includes(operation.kind)) {
      throw new RemoteError('skillhub/installation-unavailable', 'Recovery is unavailable for this operation kind.', { retryable: false });
    }
    const agentId = this.ctx.invocation!.request.args.agentId as string;
    try {
      await this.recoverInstallationOperation(agentId, operationId);
      return await this.getOperation(operationId, hostInstanceId);
    } catch {
      throw new RemoteError('skillhub/installation-unavailable', 'Recovery could not be confirmed. Query the original operation.', { retryable: true });
    }
  }

  private selectionScope(agent: { session: { id: string; header: { cwd?: string } } }) {
    this.refreshSource();
    if (!agent.session.header.cwd) throw installationContextError('CWD', 'Project unavailable.');
    this.assertSource(this.sourceRevision);
    return { sessionId: agent.session.id, cwd: agent.session.header.cwd, sourceRevision: this.sourceRevision };
  }

  /** Trusted coordinator shared by the scoped Remote and the forthcoming installation tool. */
  submitInstallation(agentId: string, input: HostInstallRequest, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<NativeOperation | undefined> {
    const runtime = this.localRuntime;
    const agent = this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agentId));
    if (!agent || !runtime) return Promise.reject(new RemoteError('skillhub/installation-unavailable', 'Installation context unavailable.', { retryable: true }));
    const request = { ...input };
    return runtime.submitInstall({ ownerId: agent.session.id, hostInstanceId: request.hostInstanceId,
      requestKey: request.requestKey, mode: request.mode, parameters: { detailToken: request.detailToken,
        targetToken: request.targetToken, initiatedFrom: request.initiatedFrom } }, () => this.prepareInstallation(agentId, request.detailToken, request.targetToken, request.initiatedFrom, signal));
  }

  private async prepareInstallation(agentId: string, detailToken: string, targetToken: string,
    initiatedFrom: 'plaza' | 'conversation', signal: AbortSignal): Promise<PreparedNativeInstall> {
    const agent = this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agentId));
    if (!agent) throw installationContextError('AGENT', 'Conversation unavailable.');
    const { target, snapshot } = await this.resolveInstallationTarget(agentId, detailToken, targetToken, signal);
    const source = this.getContext();
    const cwd = agent.session.header.cwd!;
    const filesystem = agent.ctx.get('fs');
    // An accepted operation owns its lifetime; closing the requesting panel must not cancel it.
    const operationSignal = new AbortController().signal;
    return {
      acceptance: { namespace: snapshot.namespace, slug: snapshot.slug, version: snapshot.version,
        targetLabel: target.scope === 'user' ? '当前用户' : '当前项目', targetPaths: [join(target.root, snapshot.slug)],
        context: { sourceIdentity: source.registryUrl, sourceLabel: source.registryUrl, sourceRevision: source.sourceRevision,
          hostLabel: 'DSH Host', initiatedFrom } },
      execution: { registry: source.registryUrl, namespace: snapshot.namespace, slug: snapshot.slug,
        version: snapshot.version, versionId: snapshot.versionId, fingerprint: snapshot.fingerprint, root: target.root, scope: target.scope,
        authorize: async (paths: readonly string[]) => {
          const fs = agent.ctx.get('fs');
          if (!fs || serviceIdentity(fs) !== serviceIdentity(filesystem) || agent.session.header.cwd !== cwd) throw new Error('Installation session changed');
          const policy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
          const current = await resolveInstallationPath({ scope: target.scope, cwd, fs, policy, signal: operationSignal });
          if (current.root !== target.root || current.dshHome !== target.dshHome) throw new Error('Installation root changed');
          await assertInstallationMutation(target.root, paths, policy);
        },
        validateStaged: (directory: string) => validateDshSkill(agent.ctx, directory, operationSignal),
      },
    };
  }

  async installConversationWithChoice(input: unknown, context: ConversationSearchContext, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<NativeOperation | PendingConversationInstall | CancelledConversationInstall | undefined> {

  /** Stable tool identity is checked in the journal before resolving ephemeral detail/target references. */
  async installConversation(input: unknown, context: ConversationSearchContext, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<NativeOperation | PendingConversationInstall | undefined> {
    const request = conversationInstallRequest.parse(input);
    const runtime = this.localRuntime;
    const agent = this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(context.sessionId));
    const hostInstanceId = runtime?.getStatus().hostInstanceId;
    if (!runtime || !hostInstanceId) throw installationContextError('RUNTIME', 'Installation context unavailable.');
    if (!agent) throw installationContextError('AGENT', 'Installation context unavailable.');
    if (agent.session.header.cwd !== context.cwd) throw installationContextError('CWD', 'Installation context unavailable.');
    const requestKey = conversationInstallKey({ hostInstanceId, sessionId: context.sessionId, callId: context.callId });
    const parameters = JSON.stringify({ ...request, cwd: context.cwd });
    const pending = this.pendingConversationInstalls.get(requestKey);
    if (pending) {
      if (pending.agent !== agent) throw installationContextError('AGENT', 'Conversation changed.');
      if (pending.runtime !== runtime) throw installationContextError('RUNTIME', 'Conversation changed.');
      if (pending.parameters !== parameters) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/request-conflict', 'Request parameters changed.', { retryable: false });
      const result = await pending.result;
      signal.throwIfAborted();
      this.selections.read(result.selectionRef, this.selectionScope(agent));
      if (this.localRuntime !== runtime) throw installationContextError('RUNTIME', 'Conversation changed.');
      if (this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(context.sessionId)) !== agent) throw installationContextError('AGENT', 'Conversation changed.');
      return result;
    }
    if (!request.scope) {
      // No transaction, target token, download, or fingerprint is created before visible confirmation.

  /** Internal recovery for an existing session; historical sources are never queried or reinstalled. */
  recoverInstallationOperation(agentId: string, operationId: string): Promise<NativeRecoveryResult | undefined> {
    const runtime = this.localRuntime;
    const agent = this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agentId));
    const cwd = agent?.session.header.cwd;
    const filesystem = agent?.ctx.get('fs');
    if (!runtime || !agent || !cwd || !filesystem) return Promise.reject(new Error('Recovery context unavailable'));
    const signal = new AbortController().signal;
    return runtime.recoverOperation(operationId, agent.session.id, async operation => {
      if (!['install', 'upgrade', 'uninstall', 'remove-stale-record', 'enable', 'disable'].includes(operation.kind)
        || (operation.kind === 'upgrade' ? operation.targetPaths.length < 1 || operation.targetPaths.length > 2 : operation.targetPaths.length !== 1)

        const fs = agent.ctx.get('fs');
        if (!fs || serviceIdentity(fs) !== serviceIdentity(filesystem) || agent.session.header.cwd !== cwd
          || this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agentId)) !== agent) throw new Error('Recovery session changed');
        const policy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
        const target = await resolveInstallationPath({ scope, cwd, fs, policy, signal });
        if (serviceIdentity(agent.ctx.get('fs')) !== serviceIdentity(fs) || agent.session.header.cwd !== cwd
          || this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agentId)) !== agent) throw new Error('Recovery session changed');
        return target;
      };

      for (const scope of ['user', 'project'] as const) {
        try {
          const candidate = await resolve(scope);
          if (operation.targetPaths.includes(join(candidate.root, operation.slug))
            && !targets.some(target => target.root === candidate.root)) targets.push(candidate);
        } catch { /* A denied/unavailable root cannot authorize historical mutations. */ }
      }
      if (targets.length !== operation.targetPaths.length) throw new Error('Historical installation target is unavailable in this session');
      return async paths => {
        // Revalidate the complete accepted set even when a recovery step mutates only one target.
        for (const accepted of targets) {
          const current = await resolve(accepted.scope);
          if (current.root !== accepted.root || current.dshHome !== accepted.dshHome) throw new Error('Recovery root changed');
        }
        const policy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
        if (filesystem.sandboxMode !== undefined && !policy) throw new Error('Recovery policy unavailable');
        if (operation.kind === 'install' || operation.kind === 'upgrade' || operation.kind === 'enable' || operation.kind === 'disable') {
          for (const path of paths) {
            const accepted = targets.find(target => {
              const offset = relative(target.root, path);
              return !isAbsolute(offset) && offset !== '..' && !offset.startsWith(`..${sep}`);
            });
            if (!accepted) throw new Error('Recovery mutation escaped the accepted roots');
            await assertInstallationMutation(accepted.root, [path], policy);

      };

  }

  /** Internal only: page and tool execution share this final target-reference check. */
  async resolveInstallationTarget(agentId: string, detailToken: string, targetToken: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<{
    target: ResolvedInstallationTarget; snapshot: SelectionSnapshot;
  }> {
    const agent = this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(agentId));
    if (!agent) throw installationContextError('AGENT', 'Conversation unavailable.');
    const context = { ...this.selectionScope(agent), detailToken };
    const detail = this.details.get(detailToken);
    const runtime = this.localRuntime;
    if (!detail || !detail.fingerprint) throw installationContextError('DETAIL');
    if (detail.sourceRevision !== context.sourceRevision) throw installationContextError('SOURCE');
    if (this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(context.sessionId)) !== agent) throw installationContextError('AGENT');
    if (!runtime || runtime.getStatus().state !== 'ready') {
      throw new RemoteError('skillhub/installation-unavailable', 'Local installation service is unavailable.', { retryable: true });
    }
    const fs = agent.ctx.get('fs');
    if (!fs) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/installation-unavailable', 'Filesystem unavailable.', { retryable: true });
    const combined = AbortSignal.any([signal, this.lifetime.signal]);
    const policy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
    const target = await this.installationTargets.resolve(targetToken, context, scope =>
      resolveInstallationPath({ scope, cwd: context.cwd, fs, policy, signal: combined }));
    combined.throwIfAborted();
    const current = this.selectionScope(agent);
    const currentPolicy = agent.ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')?.resolve({ session: agent.session });
    if (current.cwd !== context.cwd) throw installationContextError('CWD');
    if (current.sourceRevision !== context.sourceRevision) throw installationContextError('SOURCE');
    if (this.ctx.get('agents')?.get(SessionId(context.sessionId)) !== agent) throw installationContextError('AGENT');
    if (serviceIdentity(agent.ctx.get('fs')) !== serviceIdentity(fs)) throw installationContextError('FS');
    if (currentPolicy?.mode !== policy?.mode || currentPolicy?.workspaceRoot !== policy?.workspaceRoot) throw installationContextError('POLICY');
    if (this.localRuntime !== runtime || runtime.getStatus().state !== 'ready') throw installationContextError('RUNTIME');
    if (this.details.get(detailToken) !== detail) throw installationContextError('DETAIL');
    return { target, snapshot: { ...detail } };
  }

  /** Model adapters always supply trusted exec context; never synthesize a Remote invocation. */
  async manageConversation(action: ManagementAction, input: ManagementRequest, context: ConversationSearchContext, signal: AbortSignal, useQuestions: boolean = true): Promise<object> {

      if (runtime.getStatus().hostInstanceId !== hostInstanceId) throw new RemoteError('skillhub/context-stale', 'Host changed.', { retryable: false });
      const operation = await runtime.getOperation(operationId, context.sessionId);

    const key = JSON.stringify([context.sessionId, context.callId]);

        check: await this.checkUpdateForVersion(selected.sourceRevision, selected.itemKey, version, signal, context.sessionId) };

        ? await this.prepareUpgradeForVersion(selected.sourceRevision, selected.itemKey, version, signal, context.sessionId)
        : action === 'enable' || action === 'disable'
          ? await this.prepareToggleForAgent(selected.sourceRevision, selected.itemKey, action === 'enable' ? 'enabled' : 'disabled', signal, context.sessionId)
        : await this.prepareUninstallForAgent(selected.sourceRevision, selected.itemKey, signal, context.sessionId);
      const view: ConversationManagementResult = { schemaVersion: 1, kind: 'skillhub-management', toolCallId: context.callId,
        action: action === 'upgrade' || action === 'enable' || action === 'disable' ? action : 'uninstall', sourceRevision: selected.sourceRevision, sourceLabel: item.registry ?? source.registryUrl, item,
        status: plan.status === 'ready' ? 'awaiting-confirmation' : 'blocked', reason: plan.reason,

  private async confirmManagementForAgent(agentId: string, confirmationRef: string, confirmed: boolean, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<ConversationManagementResult> {
    const entry = this.managementConfirmations.get(confirmationRef);

    if (!entry || !agent || entry.agent !== agent || entry.runtime !== this.localRuntime
      || entry.context.sessionId !== agentId || agent.session.header.cwd !== entry.context.cwd) {

    if (entry.view.status === 'cancelled') return entry.view;
    if (entry.attempted) {
      const previous = await entry.runtime.findPlanOperation({ hostInstanceId: entry.runtime.getStatus().hostInstanceId!,

        ownerId: agentId, requestKey: entry.requestKey, mode: 'retry', parameters: { planId: entry.planId } });

  private async readSource<T>(
    sourceRevision: string, signal: AbortSignal,

    this.assertSource(sourceRevision);

  }
